name: ITFOR Inc.
summary: ITFOR Inc. designs and develops software and system infrastructure in Japan. It procures and sells system equipment; and handles network and infrastructure construction, as well as provides system engineering services and temporary staffing; software and hardware maintenance, and operation; cloud; BPO; credit investigation; and digital and payment processing services. The company also offers cashless payment solutions, contact center solutions, and security and infrastructure solutions. It serves financial institutions, public organizations, retailers, and e-commerce businesses. The company was formerly known as CJK Co. Ltd. and changed its name to ITFOR Inc. in 2000.
